name: claude-lark-plugin
description: Chat with Claude Code in real time through Feishu (Lark) with local-file memory and scheduled jobs

plugins.name: lark-v2
plugins.description: Feishu/Lark channel plugin for Claude Code (v2 fork architecture) — receive messages via WebSocket, fork per-message headless claude -p subprocess, reply with text/images/files, manage cross-session memory. ⚠️ Disable v1.x `lark` plugin first; both share ~/.claude/channels/lark/ data.
